Commentary.Commentary: England won't be too disappointed with the target they have in front of them. They did decently on the the whole, barring that period where Iqbal and Rahim were playing fluently. It was that 45th over from Plunkett that made all the difference where he dismissed both the set batsmen. With the firepower in their ranks, the hosts will back themselves to chase this down. Join us in a while for the chase.

Good comeback by England at the death. They were running the risk of Bangladesh posting a big total on the board, but have done well to recover. Bangladesh's openers took a steady approach and played sensibly. But the real impetus came via the Iqbal-Rahim partnership which consisted of 166 runs. The former scored a big ton while the latter made a brisk fifty. Some late hitting from Sabbir took them to a total past 300 but Mortaza's men will feel they fell short by at least 25-30 runs.
Bye! Hossain makes room, looks to play a reverse-batted shot. Plunkett smartly follows him. Hossain is trapped and fails to get it away. A bye is taken. BANGLADESH END ON 305/6!
Short delivery, pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Yorker in the line of the stumps, squeezed through point for a single.
Leg bye! Length delivery, angling in. Mahmudullah gets across to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads behind square on the leg side for a leg bye.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain will bat next.

OUT! Plunkett strikes again! Length delivery, angling in, Rahman clears his front leg and looks to tonk it over long on but fails to get it off the meat. Jason Roy in the deep, catches it comfortably. The dangerous Sabbir Rahman departs!
Liam Plunkett to bowl the final over of the innings.
Full outside off, Rahman looks to scoop it but then ends up gliding it to third man for a single. 300 up for Bangladesh!
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Cutter outside off, Rahman waits for it and slaps it over cover-point. The substitute Bairstow, runs to his left and makes an excellent stop before the fence. Three runs taken!
FOUR! Clever! Full outside off, Rahman gets a long way across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary. He is a very smart and handy batsman at the death.
Full outside off, steered behind point for a brace.
Length delivery, angling in, worked to fine leg for a single.
Angling into Mahmudullah, flicked to fine leg for a single.
Sabbir starts moving to his left, Wood follows him with a length delivery. Worked to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Creamed it! Full outside off, Sabbir makes slight room, kneels down and drives it over cover-point for a boundary.
Short ball, angling in, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery, Rahman makes room, looks to hammer it down the ground but mistimes it to mid off. A single is taken.
Slower delivery outside off, placed in the point region for a single.
Fuller length outside off, Sabbir looks to scoop it but then decides to glide it but misses it completely.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! Shakib holes out! Cross-seam delivery, following Shakib, who has given himself some room. The southpaw looks to loft it with the angle but fails to get power behind it. The ball travels to Stokes at long on, who pouches it with ease. Another crucial blow for Bangladesh. England are making their way back into the match.
Shakib dances down the track, makes room. Ball bowls it full and outside off. Shakib looks to go big on the off side but misses.
Full outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Put away! Cutter outside off, Rahman gets down on one knee and creams it just past extra cover for a boundary.
Jake Ball will have a change of ends.
FOUR! Banged in short, angling in, Shakib goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies over the keeper and to the fine leg fence. 10 runs off the over!
Shortish delivery, angling in, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Banged in short, Rahman ducks under it and lets it sail through.
Wood comes from around the wicket, bowls a yorker, dug out in covers for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Back of a length delivery, angling away. Shakib makes full use of the room on offer. Makes room and slaps it through covers for a boundary. That was hit very hard.
Back of a length delivery, Hasan looks to pull it but the ball goes from under his bat.
Mark Wood is back on.
On a fullish length, driven to long off for a single.
From around the wicket, it's full and speared just around off, it comes back in and just about misses the off pole. Shakib tried to dig it out but failed to do so.
Sabbir Rahman walks out in the middle. But, Shakib will be facing the hat-trick ball from Liam Plunkett.

OUT! Plunkett is on a hat-trick now! Now the hosting nation will feel they've somewhat gotten back in this game. Full and on the stumps, from over the wicket, Rahim slogs this looking to clear the fence. Doesn't middle it well enough and it's straight down the throat of Alex Hales who takes a good catch at wide long on. Both the set batsman are back in the pavilion, England can make further inroads from here.
Shakib Al Hasan strides out to bat.

OUT! Plunkett strikes again! Tamim Iqbal's fabulous knock has finally come to an end. He dug in there and did his job. Sensational stuff. Much-needed breakthrough for England, although it might have come a little late. Short and angling in, Iqbal looks to pull but gets a top edge behind. Buttler runs to his right and takes a simple catch.
Change of bat for Tamim Iqbal.
Coming back in on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Comes from around the wicket, it's full and angling in, Iqbal swings his bat and off the outer half gets it through covers for a single.
Full toss outside off, Tamim gets an outside edge as he puts bat on ball. It runs down to third man for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it fiercely aerially through point. Beats Ben Stokes out in the deep and gets another boundary.

FOUR! Oh, that's a brilliant shot. They sure play 'em well these days, don't they? Full on middle, Rahim makes room and scoops it over the keeper's head, a bit to his right. It races away to the fence for a boundary.

Full again, Rahim hits it straight back at the stumps at the other end. Ball collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end seeing Rahim out of his crease. Mushfiqur dives back in and is delighted to see the ball miss the stumps.

Fuller and tailing back in on the stumps, Mushfiqur Rahim comes down the track, makes a little room for himself and lofts it over extra cover. Seems the ball will go across the rope but Stokes out in the deep runs to his right and makes a good diving stop. Two runs taken.
Jake Ball to bowl now.
Very full, tailing in, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off. Once again Tamim mistimes his loft over mid on. The long on fielder rushes to the ball but falls short of him. A single is taken.
150-run stand between Iqbal and Rahim!
Shortish delivery, angling away, Iqbal looks to slap it away but mistimes it get over backward point. Wood in the deep, runs to his left and makes a good stop. A brace is taken.
Very full around off, squeezed to backward point.
Almost a yorker on middle, dug out well by Tamim.
Short delivery outside off, Iqbal dances down the track and looks to smash it but ends up carving it over backward point for a brace.
Liam Plunkett is back on.
Back of a length delivery, Iqbal charges down and hammers it to long on for a single.
Rahim gently dabs it to third man and gives the strike back to Tamim for a single.
Full outside off, Tamim gets down on one knee and drives it hard through point. Roy there, dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single is taken.
SIX! Glorious! Length delivery around leg, Iqbal gets across and scoops it over fine leg. For a moment, the fielder in the deep looks to be in contention but the ball clears the fence for a maximum.
Full outside off, driven on the up to covers.
Fuller length delivery in the line of the stumps, Rahim gets across and flicks it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Mark Wood is back on to bowl.
Fuller delivery, MR mistimes his slog to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Rahim kneels down to reverse sweep but misses.
Shortish delivery, cut straight to backward point.
Drifting into the southpaw, eased down to long off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Some shot, that! Tamim Iqbal dances down the track and smokes it over wide long on for a maximum.
Back of a length delivery, Rahim looks to pull it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full outside off, Iqbal kneels down and drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, pulled hard in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim looks to punch it but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip region for a single.
Wide! Rahim charges down to this back of a length delivery, looks to drag it but misses. A wide is signalled.
Wide! Banged in short, down the leg side. Rahim goes for the pull but misses. Buttler, stretches to his left, collects the ball and starts appealing. The umpire signals a wide.
Fuller length outside off, Iqbal gets low and guides it to third man for a single.
Liam Plunkett returns to the attack.
9th ODI ton for Tamim Iqbal!

2nd ODI ton against England for Tamim Iqbal! A similar delivery, Iqbal once again prods forward and turns it in the mid-wicket region. Gets it in the gap this time and the batsmen take a single. Tamim is delighted and so is the Bangladeshi dressing room. What a knock it has been from him. Superb start for Champions Trophy for them!

Hesitation in the middle! Fuller on middle, Iqbal prods forward and turns it in the mid-wicket region. Goes for a single but is sent back by Rahim seeing the fielder charge at the ball. Iqbal is furious!
Rahim goes back and punches it to wide of long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Flatter delivery, Rahim goes back and pulls it on the leg side for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, worked gently on the leg side for a single.
Moeen Ali is back on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single
Almost a yorker on middle, dug out in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.

FOUR! Fine this time! Cutter on the shorter side, Rahim waits for the ball and looks to upper cut it. Gets it off the outside edge but the ball still travels fine over the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Banged in short again, this time Rahim fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR! This is superb stuff from Rahim! Short outside off, Rahim gets on his toes and cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
This has been a good knock by Mushfiqur Rahim. He's made a good partnership with Tamim Iqbal and now, the both of them will have to change gears to help their team to a good total.
Flatter and shorter delivery, cut through point for a single.

FOUR! This time Rahim gets it through! Served fullish around off, Rahim dances down the track and drives it hard past bowler. Beats mid off as well and the ball races to the fence. That's a fifty for Rahim, His 25th in the ODIs. Also, this brings up the 100-run stand between the duo!
Iqbal waits for the ball to come to him and then works it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Rahim dances down the wicket, drives it hard straight back. Root in his followthrough, gets a hand to it and takes the pace off the ball. The mid off fielder mops it up but fails to prevent the single.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, driven through extra cover for a single.
Full on the stumps, dug out to mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Rahim gets on his toes and defends it square of the wicket on the leg side. Tamim calls through for a quick single and completes it.
FOUR! Clever shot! Short and angling away, Rahim gets underneath the ball and places it over backward point for a boundary.
Pitched outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Once again it's in the air but safe! Back of a length delivery, angling in, Iqbal looks to pull it but is early in his shot. Ends up mistiming it just past short mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery, sliding in, Tamim goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Spinning into the pads, worked on the leg side for a single.

In the air... but safe! Rahim looks to go after Root. Dances down the track, looks to loft it over the bowler's head but miscues it. Luckily the ball falls in no man's land in the long on region and a couple is taken.
Flatter delivery, slanting away, Rahim cuts it straight to the man at point.
Iqbal backs away and drives it through mid off for a single.
In the air for a moment! Sliding into the batsman, Iqbal looks to push it down the track but checks his shot. The ball is in the air for a while but falls short of Root.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, tucked in the square leg region for a single.
Angling away from Rahim, who opens the face of the bat and dabs it behind square on the off side for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tamim gets a touch low and guides it to third man for a single.
On a length outside off, defended down the track.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim stays tall and cuts it through point. Plunkett in the deep covers good ground on his left and keeps it down to a single.
Angling into the batsman, worked square on the leg side for a single.
Jake Ball is back on.
Time for a drinks break!
Quite straight in line, fuller in length, worked away towards short fine leg for one run.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, another wide called.
Flat and fuller in length, catches Tamim low on the pads who attempts to flick. Muted appeal but it's turned down.
Wide! Slips it down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Bowls it full, in the line of the stumps, it's played back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and off, wristed down to long on for a run.
Bowls it slower through the air this time, it's going across, Rahim wrists it to the right of the bowler. Thinks of taking the run but then decides against it.
From around the wicket, it's full and flat on middle and off, eased down to long off for a single.
Now, Joe Root comes into the attack!
Things are heating up in the middle as Tamim Iqbal didn't like when Stokes put his arm over his shoulders. The umpires come in the centre, have a chat with the batsman and calm things down.

Full and angling in on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single. Stokes on his way back tells him something again as he keeps his hands on his shoulder. Tamim does not appreciate that one bit and is furious.
Full on off, driven to mid off. Stokes once again has a few words with him, but the left-hander just indicates that he walk back and continue on with his bowling. Good little heated battle here.
Outside off, hit to point for no run.

FOUR! Deft from the southpaw. He waits for this length ball and opens the face at the last second. Dabs it through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary. Stokes has a piece of advice for Tamim, the two exchange words.
From around the wicket, it's hurled on a length outside off, Tamim goes for the expansive drive through the covers but fails to make any kind of connection.
Full toss outside off, driven to sweeper cover for one run.
Spills it on the hips, tucked away square on the leg side for a run.
Short of a good length on the body, turned with the wrists in front of mid-wicket for a quick one.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and cuts it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short delivery pounded outside off, Mushfiqur arches back and has nothing to do with that.
Back of a length on the stumps, worked past square leg for a run.
Rahim pulls out of the shot as he was unsure of the field changes and so wanted to make sure before playing.
Sharp, accurate bumper on middle and leg, leaves Tamim Iqbal in no man's land with that. The left-hander just about manages to sway away and let it go over him.
Outside off, guides it to third man. They pick up a single.

Stokes switches the angle and comes from around the wicket, angles in a short ball which hurries Tamim Iqbal into the pull shot. He scuffs it aerially past short mid-wicket towards mid on. Rahim wants the run but is sent back, good call too. Wood at mid on had a shy at the bowler's end. He missed, but would have been close had that hit.
Fuller in length outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Length delivery on off, Mushfiqur cuts it away but doesn't completely go through with the shot. Checks a bit as he plays it straight to backward point.
Quite full on off, drilled to the left of the mid off fielder to cuts it off.
Once again it's on Tamim's pads, the English bowlers are going to get nowhere with this. Need to adjust the line. It's clipped through square leg for a run.
Yorker on off, swinging back in, jammed out to mid on.
Too straight again, easy for the southpaw to work it behind square leg for a single.

FOUR! Anything slightly short and it's punished. On the hips, Tamim Iqbal rises on his toes and pulls it away in front of square for a boundary. Good placement, good timing. This is good cricket from this batting pair.
Bit straighter in line, on middle and leg, Iqbal whips it but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Drops it in the off stump channel, steered to third man for an easy run.
Full from Wood, nice and straight, driven back down the ground. The fielder from mid on moves to his left and cuts it off.
Mark Wood returns to the bowling attack.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, the batsman goes back and cuts it late down to third man for one.
Fired full and wide outside off, Mushfiqur reaches out to thump the drive through the covers, but fails to connect.
Tamim works this one through mid-wicket and jogs over to the other end.
Good length ball on the fifth stump line, driven through to deep cover for a single.

FOUR! What a shot! Completely in control as he dispatched that. Back of a length around off, Mushfiqur Rahim picks up the length and gets into position to pull. It's cleared the infield over mid-wicket and raced away to the rope. 50-run stand between Rahim and Iqbal is up!
Jagging back in on middle and leg, takes Rahim by surprise and raps him on the gloves.
Ben Stokes back into the attack.
Tossed up delivery attacking the stumps, wristed through the square leg area for a single.
Sliding in on the pads, clipped fine down the leg side to rotate strike.
Around the wicket, it's shorter in length, the left-hander ensures it's dealt with easily.
Over the wicket again, it's short outside off, Rahim backs away and cuts it square through point. It won't go all the way but it's enough to fetch him three good runs.
From around the wicket, it's short and flat around off, Tamim goes back and whips it down to long on for a single.
Spinning in on middle and leg, tucked behind square on the leg side. One run taken.
A bit uppish from Rahim as he flicks this but it's well in the gap. Plays it through mid-wicket for one run.
Back of a length delivery quite close to off, kept out rather solidly.
Pitched outside off, on a length, guided to third man for a single.

FOUR! Shot. Overpitched and gets the treatment. Full on the stumps, Iqbal drives it straight back. The ball goes over the rope and Ball goes over the fence with the momentum while chasing it down from mid off.
FOUR! Too straight in line and it's put away. Iqbal glances this through backward square leg and beats the man out in the deep who tries to cut it off.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Mushfiqur glances it off his pads behind square on the leg side for a run.
Tossed up on the stumps, tucked past square leg for a single.
Iqbal rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball down to long on. They pick up a single.
Outside off on a length, run down to short third man.
SIX! Floats it up on leg, Tamim makes good use of his feet and goes inside out. Smokes it over extra cover and sends it sailing into the stands for a maximum. That's a great hit.
Tossed up outside off from around the wicket, driven to mid off.
Straighter one around off, Mushfiqur Rahim off the outer half plays it to backward point for a single.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man with an open face for a run.
Positions himself behind the line, hangs back and blocks.
On a good length, pitched outside off, Rahim opens the face and dabs it square on the off side.
Back of a length, jagging back in from outside off, Mushfiqur from within his crease defends.
Length delivery just around off, seaming away, Tamim backs away a touch and guides it down to third man. A single is taken.
Bit ahead of a length, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim turns this through square leg and rotates strike.
Makes good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flighted on the pads, worked away behind square on the leg side for one.
Drops this on a driving length, on off, strides forward and keeps it out.
Tosses it right up there, it's pushed back in the direction of the bowler.

Straighter one outside off, Rahim moves well across to scoop it over the keeper's head. Root chases after the ball and puts it in an excellent dive to keep it just inside the rope. Good effort. He had actually premeditated that and moved to the leg side even before Mushfiqur played it, but it went just over him. Three runs taken.
Bowled on a back of a length, it is blocked by the southpaw.
37th ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal!
FOUR! Fifty for Tamim! He's taken his time to settle in, but has dug in well to stroke a good half century. He cuts this away well past point for a boundary.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Sprays it on the pads once more, worked away fine on the leg side for a single.
Angling in on middle and leg, Rahim picks it off his pads and works it in front of square on the leg side. Runs the first one hard and manages to come back for the second.

FOUR! That's a top, top shot. Pure timing, everything about that was mesmerizing. Fuller in length around off, Rahim leans into the shot and drives it past the cover fielder. It races away to the fence for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Maiden from Moeen Ali!
Looped up right on the stumps, driven back down the track.
Floats it up around off, Iqbal is forward in defense.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bit flatter outside off, Iqbal hangs back and dabs it with an angled bat past first slip.
Some nice drift into the batsman, Iqbal plays it straight back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid off. End of a successful over by Plunkett!
Slightly back of a length outside off, Rahim gets on his toes and blocks it.
Angling away from the southpaw, glided to third man for a single.
Rahim gets off the mark straightaway as he flick the length ball down to fine leg for one.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks into the middle next.

OUT! Superb catch from Wood! Change of bowling does the trick for England! Plunkett bowls it slightly fuller around middle, Kayes clears his front leg and looks to loft it over mid on but fails to connect cleanly. The ball travels to the widish mid on region. Wood at mid on, runs a couple of steps to his left, dives and completes a wonderful catch. England are delighted!
Length delivery, angling away, Kayes covers the stumps and defends.
Liam Plunkett will have a change of ends.
Shout for lbw! Slanting into the batsman, Tamim prods forward to play but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but once again it's turned down. Sliding down leg, maybe!
Flatter and straighter delivery, sliding in, Kayes looks to push it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge on the leg side for a single.
Off spinner outside off, Kayes leaves it alone.
Mid-wicket goes back and long on comes inside the circle.
Sliding into the pads, flicked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Floats it around middle and off, Iqbal pushes it to covers.
Drifts it in on middle and leg, driven back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good placement! Short and wide outside off, Kayes smartly plays an upper cut over the slip cordon for a boundary. The Bangladeshi batsmen are ticking along nicely.
Pitched outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Slanting into Kayes, he plays with the angle in the mid-wicket region and takes a quick single.

The news from the dressing room is that Chris Woakes' injury is a bit more severe than expected. His side strain won't allow him to take the field, not soon anyway. Remains to be seen when he'll participate, if he does.
Angling into the batsman, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, angling in, Iqbal moves across a touch and defends.
Full on middle, driven to long off for a single.
Another slider from Ali, defended off the back foot on the off side.
Wide! Full but down the leg side. Iqbal leaves it and gets a wide.
Sliding into the pads, played with the angle on the leg side.
Flatter delivery, punched off the back foot to covers.
Slanting into the batsman, worked behind square on the leg side. Stokes there has a wild throw at the keeper's end and allows the batsmen to take a second off the overthrow.

Shout for lbw! Arm ball first up from Moeen Ali. Iqbal prods forward to defend but plays down the wrong line. Gets rapped on the back leg and the players appeal for lbw but it's turned down. The replays shows that it could have gone down leg!
Moeen Ali is brought into the attack. There's a slip in place.
Drinks break!
Kayes shuffles across a touch and pushes the length delivery back to the bowler.
Beaten! Back of a length outside off, Kayes looks to punch it on the off side but the ball doesn't come in with the angle as much as he expects and so gets beaten on his outside edge.
Short and angling in. Iqbal gets on his toes and places it in front of square on the leg side and takes a quick single.
Angling down leg, Kayes works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Crossed seam delivery from Stokes, pushed back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a couple.
Another play and a miss! A touch ahead of a length outside off, Iqbal looks to drive it off the front foot again but once again is beaten.
This time Plunkett bowls it quick outside off. Iqbal goes for the drive again but is beaten by pace this time!
FOUR! Edged and away! Slower one full outside off, Iqbal goes for an expansive drive. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs quickly to the third man fence. Back-to-back boundaries for Tamim!
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller length delivery, angling in, Iqbal drives it through the line. Beats the man at mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Angling into the pads, flicked to deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Iqbal stands tall and pushes it in front of covers for a quick single.
Length delivery, slanting away, Iqbal bends both his knees and glides it to third man for a single. 11 runs off the over!
Shortish delivery, Iqbal mistimes his pull to square leg.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Flicked away! Now, Stokes bowls it full on middle, Kayes just flicks it off his pads over square leg for a boundary.
A slip in place now. Something which Morgan should have done before itself.

FOUR! Edged and through! Why isn't there a slip for the new batsman? Stokes comes from around the wicket, bowls it slightly back of a length outside off, Kayes plays with an angled bat but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon. Buttler dives full stretch to his left but fails to reach it and the ball races to the fence behind.
Angling away from Iqbal, dabbed to third man for a single.
Once again Kayes feels for the fullish delivery outside off and gets beaten again.
Beaten! A touch ahead of length outside off, Kayes prods forward to defend but the ball straightens a touch after pitching and the ball goes past the outside edge.
Wide outside off, Imrul lets it go.
Length delivery around middle and off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straight delivery in the line of the stumps, Iqbal turns it on the leg side and takes a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Liam Plunkett comes into the attack now.
Imrul Kayes walks out at no.3!

OUT! Stokes provides the breakthrough! Short and angling away, Sarkar hops a touch and looks to glide it over on the off side. Fails to get it fine and the ball goes square of the wicket on the off side. The substitute Bairstow at deep cover-point, gets underneath the ball and pouches it with ease. Superb over from Stokes, a wicket and just 4 runs from it.
Punched on the up off the back foot to covers.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery around middle and leg, skids through. Sarkar looks to drag it but gets an inside edge onto the pads and on the leg side. A single is taken.
Slightly on the shorter side of a length, angling away, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, slapped through cover-point for a single.
Wide! Fails to get his line right, Stokes. Sprays it full but down the leg side. Iqbal fails to connect and a wide is signalled.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack now!

FOUR! Creamed! Overpitched delivery outside off, Sarkar shifts his weight onto the front foot and drives it through covers. There's a big gap there and the ball races to the fence. 16 runs off the over!
Short delivery, angling in. Iqbal mistimes his pull on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven on the up through cover-point. There's a fielder in the deep now and so just a single taken.
FOUR! Cut away! Back of a length delivery, wide outside off, Soumya latches onto the width on offer and cuts it in front of square on the off side for a boundary.
Banged in short outside off, Sarkar looks to upper cut it but misses. He seems to be attacking everything now.
SIX! Length delivery outside off, Sarkar dances down the track and tonks it over long on for a maximum. Superb start to the over. Bangladesh getting a move on now!
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner ring now till the 40th over.
FOUR! Another top edge but he's made better connection this time. Iqbal pulls it over square leg and sends it across the rope for a boundary.

What happened there? Some good, alert stuff saves Tamim Iqbal. Wood bangs it in short on leg, Iqbal looks to fend it away but it lobs off the top edge. He doesn't know at first where the ball is. It drops and is spinning back in from the leg side to hit the stumps. The batsman does well to kick it away. Smiles and chuckles all around from the England players.
Stays behind to this one and keeps it out.
Short of a length outside off, Soumya pushes it in front of mid off and takes another quick run.
On the shorter side of the length, a little outside off, it's at a good pace and this hurries Sarkar into the pull shot. He mistimes it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for nothing.
Good length delivery on middle, Iqbal works it in front of mid-wicket and scurries across to complete the run.
Single to end the over. Tamim just works this behind square on the leg side and runs across.
Angling in on a good length, Iqbal wrists it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Fuller length delivery from Jake Ball, driven towards the mid on fielder.
Hurls it on a length, outside off, Tamim leans ahead and lets it through.
FOUR! Angling down leg, Iqbal makes Ball pay for the poor line. He just whips it fine down the leg side and beats the diving fine leg fielder to get a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Liam Plunkett is off the field. David Willey replaces him in the middle. So now, two substitutes are out on the ground for England.
Fuller delivery which is driven to the mid off fielder.
Shorter ball angling in, pulled away to mid-wicket.
Outside off on a good length, run down to third man for an easy run.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot, absolutely beautiful. Quite full on middle and off, Tamim stands his ground and drives it straight back. It's hit so perfectly nobody has a chance to stop that.
On a good length, Iqbal works it away on the leg side for no run.
Short of a length delivery to Tamim Iqbal, defended off the back foot.

DROPPED! Moeen Ali puts down an easy one. Everybody probably thought Bangladesh have lost their first wicket of the day. Wouldn't blame 'em either. Full and angling in, Sarkar flicks it uppishly in front of square leg. Ali moves to his left and gets both his hands to it, only to spill it. Was a dolly, should have been taken that. Soumya Sarkar survives. Maiden over from Ball!
Back of a length delivery which is comfortably blocked out by Soumya Sarkar.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Angling in, worked away on the leg side.
Ooohh... That was close. It hits the deck and straightens up considerably. Sarkar has a tame push at it and almost edges it as it goes through to the keeper.
From around the wicket, it's full on the stumps, driven to mid on.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Short and it's rising quickly on Tamim Iqbal. He looks to pull but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, it flies over Jos Buttler who leaps to try and take it. Boundary to end the over.
Length delivery shaping away, negotiated well from inside his crease.
On middle and leg, worked away to square leg. No run taken.

That would have been really close. Too early and absolutely unnecessary to take chances at this stage of the game. Sarkar turns this towards square leg and takes off. Jonny Bairstow, the substitute fielder, moves to his left and fires a throw at the striker's end. Just misses, but had that hit its mark, Tamim would have been gone.
Length ball on off, Soumya with a back foot defense to see it out.
Full and outside off, Iqbal goes for the booming drive. Ends up playing it off the outer half of the bat past point for a single.
Bit dangerous. Ball bowls a length ball outside off, Sarkar wants to leave it but does so very late. The ball goes off the bottom part of the willow behind to the slip cordon.
Shaping in on a back of a length, kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Two in two for Sarkar. He's getting a move on here now. Sees the full ball outside off and creams the drive through the covers to send it across the rope.
FOUR! Too full, too straight and it's punished. Angling in on leg, Sarkar picks it off his pads and flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary. First one of the tournament.
Angling in once again, around off, defended.
Jake Ball starts his spell from around the wicket, angles in a length ball on middle and off, Soumya Sarkar stays behind the line and defends.
Jake Ball replaces Woakes.
Fullish delivery speared outside off, Iqbal drives it to the right of mid off.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven straight to the mid on fielder for nothing.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Coming back into the batsman, he's struck on the thigh pad as he attempts to put bat on ball.

Super piece of fielding from Jason Roy. Tamim hangs back and opens the face to dab it to the right of backward point. Roy runs and dives to stop it. Stops the batsmen from taking a run as he quickly fires a throw at the striker's end.
Tight line from Mark Wood as he pitches this on a back of a length, very close to off stump as it's solidly kept out from Tamim.
Chris Woakes is off the field. After he delivered the last ball, he held his waist. A bit of side strain maybe. Let's hope that it's not too serious. Jonny Bairstow is on the field in his place.
On the shorter side of things, it's defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shot. Fuller length delivery straighter in line, Tamim Iqbal leans ahead and flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder. It's a big boundary out there so the batsmen get three.
Length delivery on off, Tamim offers a straight blade in defense.

In the air but it's well away from the fielder. Woakes bowls a back of a length delivery well outside off, Soumya Sarkar stands tall and punches it uppishly. It through the right of the backward point fielder and one run is taken as third man mops it up in the deep. A bit indecisive in the running though from the Bangladeshi batsmen.
Short and on off, Sarkar gets on top of the bounce and defends it down in front of covers.
Shortish length delivery holding its line around off, Sarkar steers it along the ground towards gully.
Just back of a length again, blocked out with a straight blade to end the over.
Wide! Wood goes short and really bends his back this time, it's too short though as the umpire signals it as a wide.
Short of a good length, shaping away from around off, kept out off the back foot rather solidly.
On a back of a length, in the off stump channel, Tamim makes a watchful leave.

That's an excellent effort from Eoin Morgan, setting an example early up. Sarkar lunges forward and drives this hard towards extra cover. The English captain dives full stretch to his left and does extremely well to get a hand on it. Saves a certain boundary and the batsmen can only take one.
Length delivery around off, Sarkar keeps it out from deep within his crease.
Attacks straightaway. Gets this length delivery to come back in, Mark Wood. Soumya Sarkar attempts to play across the line but is rapped on the pads. No appeal there as it was going down leg.
Mark Wood to bowl from the other new ball.
A maiden to start things off with. Makes this one go away from around off, Iqbal with a slightly opened face dabs it down square on the off side.
Angling across on a good length, Tamim offers a firm back foot punch but it's straight to the man at cover.
That's going a long way across. It's on a length as Tamim lets it be.
Good length delivery quite close to the off pole, hangs back in defense as he drops it down on the ground on the on side.
Another one full in length, on the base of off stump, Tamim leans ahead a touch and drives it to mid off.
Not much swing there, maybe a slight hint of movement away. Woakes fires it full and just outside off, Tamim Iqbal prods forward in defense but is beaten past the outside edge.
The two Bangladeshi openers, Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar have taken their place in the centre. Chris Woakes to start with the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
The players have made their way out in the middle and are getting ready for their respective national anthems.
BANGLADESH XI - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Imrul Kayes, Mushfiqur Rahim(WK), Mahmudullah, Shakib Al Hasan, Sabbir Rahman, Mosaddek Hossain, Mashrafe Mortaza(C), Rubel Hossain, Mustafizur Rahman.
ENGLAND XI - Jason Roy, Alex Hales, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(C), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(WK), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Liam Plunkett, Mark Wood, Jake Ball.

Pitch Report - There will be some movement for the pacers. The England bowlers will get a lot of movement and bounce, but it will all depend on how they use it and how the Bangladesh batsmen apply themselves, reckons Ian Bishop.

Mashrafe Mortaza says that they would have bowled first as well. Mentions that there will be swing on offer early on but overall it looks a good wicket. Adds that they will have to post a good total and then field well. Informs that all his players are fit. Says that in the last couple of years, they have improved but so have England. Ends by saying that they don't fear the opposition and would look to play hard cricket out in the middle.

Eoin Morgan says they will bowl first. Adds it's a 1030 start and the wicket looks good, so if the wicket will do anything it'll do it now. Mentions everybody is fit and it's more or less the same team that played against South Africa in Leeds. Let's everybody know there's one change as Jake Ball comes in for Adil Rashid. When asked about Jason Roy's patchy form, he says that he's been doing well in the nets and backs him completely. Opines there's no trouble with Ben Stokes, just a tactical change (On whether getting Ball in was to cover him). Ends by saying that it's a huge compliment that they've been tipped as favourites and is relishing the challenge.
TOSS - ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND HAVE ELECTED TO FIELD FIRST!

Last time when these two sides met in an ICC tournament, it was the 2015 ODI World Cup, where the Asian team got the better of the then English side. Times have changed since then and England would be aiming for revenge in front of the home crowd while Bangladesh would look to create another upset. Toss coming up!

Hello and a warm welcome to the opening game of the Champions Trophy, 2017. The first match will be taking place between the hosts, England and Bangladesh at The Oval. The home side are looking very strong in the ODI format and are coming into this tournament fresh from a series win against South Africa. Bangladesh also would be high on confidence as they have risen to their highest ever ranking in the ODIs.
